items: 48th Session, UNESCO World Heritage Committee, Busan, South Korea; India rank: 6th globally, 2nd in Asia-Pacific; 69 sites on Tentative List; makes 3 of Buddhism's 4 holiest sites UNESCO-listed (Lumbini, Bodh Gaya, Sarnath).
